stories.title: World’s largest liquid-air storage facility comes online in China
stories.description: China’s 60 MW/600 MWh liquid-air energy storage facility in Qinghai began generating electricity on October 30, marking a major milestone in long-duration energy storage commercialization. The world’s largest grid-connected LAES project offers 10 hours of continuous power output, supporting renewable energy integration with domestically developed technology.

stories.title: Türkiye targets 175 GW of solar, wind capacity by 2040
stories.description: Türkiye's energy vision for 2040 aims to increase renewables' share of the country's total installed capacity to 77%, from around 63% today.

stories.title: Software squeezes more data out of Webb Telescope for imaging exoplanets
stories.description: Software optimizes a physical model of the telescope to reduce noise.

stories.title: Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage
stories.description: A sales representative asks an AI agent for customer pricing, and the agent pulls data from multiple sources: restricted pricing systems, internal communications, and archived quotes. The output looks accurate to the agent, so a second agent uses the data to draft the proposal for the sales rep. No human checks either handoff.

stories.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots
stories.description: Serve Robotics announced alonsgside its third-quarter earnings that it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services to offer customers its connectivity and data tools.

stories.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
stories.description: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

stories.title: 'I've taken an extra job to pay for heating oil'
stories.description: People in Sussex say they are taking on extra work and not heating their homes due to oil prices.

stories.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
stories.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

stories.title: MIND: AI Co-Scientist for Material Research
stories.description: arXiv:2604.13699v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic AI systems for scientific discovery, but most approaches remain limited to textbased reasoning without automated experimental verification. We propose MIND, an LLM-driven framework for automated hypothesis validation in materials research.

stories.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
stories.description: arXiv:2611.08478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature.

stories.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
stories.description: arXiv:2611.08483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods.

stories.title: Ny strømforbindelse i Narvik styrker strømforsyningen i Nordland
stories.description: Det nye 132 kV kabelanlegget over Rombaksfjorden i Narvik er satt i drift. Kabelanlegget vil styrke strømnettet i Narvik, Lofoten, Vesterålen og Harstad-området.
